label: WhatsApp Receive (Baileys)
description: Fires an execution when a WhatsApp message arrives at the project's WhatsApp bridge. Wire this node's `endpointUrl` input from a BaileyBridge node; the listener subscribes to the bridge's SSE events stream and fires on every `message.received` event.

inputs.name: endpointUrl
inputs.description: Output of a BaileyBridge node. The listener subscribes to <endpointUrl without /action>/events.

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: Stored-file reference for image/video/audio/document/sticker messages; absent for text.

outputs.name: fileSize
outputs.description: The media's size in bytes, as WhatsApp reports it before anything is downloaded; absent for text. Gate on it to refuse a file too large to process.

outputs.name: seconds
outputs.description: The length of a voice note or a video, in seconds; absent for anything else. Gate on it to refuse an hour-long voice note before paying to transcribe it.
